findings.highlight: she is only helping me to take share in the reward
findings.evidenceJa: その手伝いとして俺を助けてくれているだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes Saber helps him instrumentally because only a Master can obtain the Grail for her goal.
findings.explanation: The English suggests she helps Shirou so that he can share in the reward, reversing beneficiary and purpose.

findings.governingReading: Shirou calls asking about another’s wish sacrilegious when he lacks a clear wish himself.
findings.explanation: The English reduces moral-spiritual violation to poor manners.
